findings.reason: on the branch the plan anticipates (§18's own reported shape no longer reachable), the only declared red arm is unfalsifiable, so the node either blocks at promotion or ships a gate that proves nothing; the control must instead name a product behaviour (the obligations view reporting the hand-made record with that path as its reason) that fails at the base revision and passes at the same head that delivers §18's reporting.
findings.text: the negative control's "shape no longer reachable" arm runs the path test against a request record written by hand "whose brief lies in a foreign run directory, which the test reads as a violation naming that path"; that violation is the test's own assertion (the invariant the fallback test already asserts, that a brief lies inside its own or the reviewed run's directory), so the hand-made record fails at the delivered revision exactly as it does at the base revision. As an arm it cannot show a guard the section adds, and it cannot satisfy promotion's rule that the red log carry a failing test id the head arm does not fail, so the node that takes this branch cannot promote on the control the plan names
